verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs describe a pay-run flow where you review timesheets inside the pay run, compare it with previous runs to catch discrepancies before final approval, add bonuses and pay types, and then hit "Run." Together these cover review, preview and submit in one flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a totals/preview summary screen, detailed step-by-step pay-run docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: You can even review timesheets right inside each pay run.
Rippling lets you compare your current pay run with previous ones to catch discrepancies before final approval.
